A design loop solves several designs in one process, on one mesh, one `gfem.solve` at one frequency each: design $i$ scales the permittivity of the highest-permittivity volume by $1 + 10^{-3} i$, so the designs' S differ by design. Design 0 is the first solve. An analysis kept is the coarse problem's ordering and symbolic factorization from an earlier design, which then only refactors; its analysis and factorization are MUMPS's printed times. The coarse apply per call is the slowest rank's time over the calls. The running total adds the designs' `gfem.solve`; the mesh read comes before design 0. The largest node's memory is its peak so far. `tol` is `SolverOptions.tolerance`, GMRES's relative preconditioned residual; it does not apply to `direct`.
